promptTemplate: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one isolated technology logo image for an existing dark navy website card. Subject: {subject}. Render a faithful, clean, immediately recognizable {name} logo symbol in its standard brand colors, centered with generous transparent padding. Crisp flat logo artwork, no bevels, no photorealism, no shadows, no scene. Transparent background. Single emblem only, no extra captions, names, labels, borders, UI, watermark or surrounding text (retain only letters integral to the described emblem). Square composition; emblem occupies about 70 percent of the canvas. Keep edges sharp and high contrast on dark navy.
